featured_reviews.name: Ganesh Subramanian
featured_reviews.review_text:
Joining Nalas Swimming Class in Vasai completely changed my experience in regard to the approach of learning Swimming. Under the excellent guidance of Coach Ninad, I was able to confidently perform freestyle swimming within just 8 sessions.

What truly makes Ninad different is the hands-on coaching approach, he personally gets into the pool, patiently demonstrates every movement in detail, corrects mistakes instantly, and ensures each student learns with proper technique and confidence rather than just “managing to swim.” The training environment is motivating, supportive, and highly professional.

If someone who is struggling to swim can finally learn swimming with ease here, I can confidently say this is one of the best swimming coaching classes in Vasai and would recommend anyone to blindly go ahead and join, I can vouch for that.

featured_reviews.review_text: It was a great experience to learn from Ninad Sir. He was very patient while teaching, also techniques were well explained and were given good practical experience. It is good place to spend your adult money. Worth doing it. Enjoyed

featured_reviews.review_text:
Joining Nala's is the best decision I made.
Swimming is a life skill and both Ninad and Krutika teach swimming with logic and patience.
They are the best and kindest instructors. In my entire duration of learning swimming with them, they have taught me with the right technique and have instilled so much confidence in me. Another thing I love is that they always keep the batches small with limited number of students so they are able to give proper tailored attention to each student which makes a world of difference.

The pool is extremely clean and fully safe which is unlike any of the pools in Vasai and the vibe is just all hearts!

featured_reviews.review_text:
If you're looking for a place to learn swimming, I would highly recommend Rose Delight. This is more like a community driven project. There’s a real "family vibe" here that puts you at ease the moment you walk in.

The trainers—Paul, Daniel and the larger team—are fantastic. They have a massive amount of patience and a clear love for what they do, especially when it comes to teaching kids.

I have personally seen my 7yo son go step by step and learn swimming in just a few sessions.

Paul and team really take huge efforts and patience to train the technical stuff like breathing, floating, and building up stamina so you don't get tired out.

It’s a great spot for both adults and children to learn. It’s rare to find a place that cares this much about the people they are teaching. If you want to learn swimming in a supportive, loving, and professional setting, this is the perfect place to dive in! 🏊🏼‍♂️

featured_reviews.name: Sandesh Padyar
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is a well-developed infrastructure project by the VVMC. Inaugurated in 2009, the pool has been operational regularly for the last 17 years (except during the COVID-19 pandemic), which is highly commendable. If you want to pursue swimming as a hobby at an affordable rate of just 500 INR per month, this is a great choice.
​Pros:
​Olympic Size: Because it is built to Olympic standards, it easily handles a crowd of 70 to 80 members per batch without feeling overly congested.
​Water Upkeep: Water cleanliness issues arise occasionally, but the management is generally quick to address and resolve them.
​Cons & Areas for Improvement:
​Staff Management: Except for 2 or 3 efficient lifeguards, the rest of the staff is quite passive. They also tend to rush members out, closing the batch 10 minutes prior to the official end time.
​Changing Room Maintenance: The facility lacks basic amenities. The locker system has been discontinued, there are no racks to store bags, and there aren't enough benches to sit on while changing.
​Plumbing & Safety: The shower taps and fittings are in poor condition. Additionally, there are no anti-skid mats installed in the changing or shower areas, making them slippery and unsafe.
​Verdict: An excellent budget-friendly Olympic-sized facility for local residents, provided you can overlook the average upkeep of the changing rooms.

featured_reviews.name: Mahendra Shelke
featured_reviews.review_text: amazing pool and good staff especially for a beginner it's good and also the fee structure is very less as compared to other pools in the vicinity

featured_reviews.name: Harsh
featured_reviews.review_text: Very affordable price monthly membership is available. Nice place to start for those who want learn swimming trainers are available apart from that different floats are also there. parking arrangement is provided and it is free. Water is not clean, but you can't expect a clean pool at that price. Locker's facility is also provided.

featured_reviews.name: sumit mhatre
featured_reviews.review_text: Having a huge swimming pool, expert trainers, and affordable fees, starting from Rs.1000 /mo.  They are very disciplined, punctual, have good time management, and there are many trainers. They always stay alert to prevent any accidents. There is a huge gallery where parents can sit and observe their child's progress. There are also two separate batches exclusively for ladies, with only female trainers, and during those batches, no gents are allowed in the swimming pool or the gallery.

featured_reviews.review_text: Good swimming pool and continuously monitored by coaches
